about.title: About Our Company
about.textPost: dedicated to creating a sustainable future by responsibly managing discarded electronic devices. Founded with the vision of reducing environmental impact, we specialize in the collection, processing, and recycling of computers, smartphones, tablets, and other electronic equipment. Our state-of-the-art facilities ensure that valuable materials like gold, silver, and rare earth elements are recovered and reused, while hazardous substances are safely disposed of according to international environmental standards. Through partnerships with businesses, educational institutions, and communities, we've successfully diverted millions of pounds of e-waste from landfills, contributing to a circular economy where technology serves both progress and planetary health.

collections.subtitle: What We Accept
collections.title: Our Waste Collections
collections.textPre: We collect a wide range of
collections.textPost: across five main categories: paper, plastic, metal, e-waste, and mixed waste. Whether it's an old laptop, a broken phone, spare cables, or general recyclable packaging, each item is sorted, weighed, and processed responsibly. Every category has its own collection rate, so the more you recycle, the more you can earn back — while keeping electronics and other waste out of landfills and giving valuable materials a second life.
